Commands.Label: Cast a spell
Commands.Help: Choose a spell name. Use on self, on last or on saved "name". Targeting waits automatically.

Commands.Label: Use a skill
Commands.Help: Spell and skill names ignore spaces, capitals, hyphens and underscores.

Commands.Label: Open backpack
Commands.Help: Opens your backpack. Open inner bags yourself before searching or moving their contents.

Commands.Label: Open map
Commands.Help: Opens the game map.

Commands.Label: Dismount
Commands.Help: Gets off your mount.

Commands.Label: War mode
Commands.Help: Choose on or off.

Commands.Label: Attack last target
Commands.Help: Saved friends, party members and yourself remain protected.

Commands.Label: Primary ability
Commands.Help: Requests your primary weapon ability.

Commands.Label: Secondary ability
Commands.Help: Requests your secondary weapon ability.

Commands.Label: Toggle flight
Commands.Help: Toggles flight when supported by your character and shard.

Commands.Label: Target yourself
Commands.Help: Waits up to five seconds for a fresh target cursor, then targets you.

Commands.Label: Target last
Commands.Help: Uses your last target after waiting for a fresh cursor.

Commands.Label: Target saved object
Commands.Help: Use Choose an object to give something a memorable saved name.

Commands.Label: Target ground
Commands.Help: X, Y, Z and optional graphic. A scanned tile can instead be targeted by its loop name.

Commands.Label: Wait for cursor
Commands.Help: Normally automatic when targeting. An expired wait stops the script.

Commands.Label: Cancel cursor
Commands.Help: Cancels the currently available target cursor through the checked runner.

Commands.Label: Use an item
Commands.Help: Use a saved object, exact name or graphic. Add on self, on last or on a scanned tile.

Commands.Label: Equip an item
Commands.Help: Equip a saved item in a named layer, such as right hand or cloak.

Commands.Label: Find items
Commands.Template: items.find graphic 0x1BDD in backpack as logs
Commands.Help: Searches the open source bag, without entering nested bags. Names must match the cached item name.

Commands.Label: Put items in a bag
Commands.Template: items.move graphic 0x1BDD to saved "wood bag" amount all from backpack
Commands.Help: Move all matching stacks or an exact total amount. Open both bags first. Each move must be observed before continuing.

Commands.Label: Find nearby trees
Commands.Help: Collects all pages around your starting position; closest tiles first. Incomplete scans stop with an explanation.

Commands.Label: Find cave tiles
Commands.Help: Finds currently loaded cave tiles. This does not mine them.

Commands.Label: Find a tile graphic
Commands.Help: Use graphic or name to narrow the scan. A custom shard may use different graphics.

Commands.Label: Find windows
Commands.Help: Search visible gump text or a graphic. This is read-only; use gumps.wait and gumps.press to reply.

Commands.Label: Walk to a location
Commands.Help: Nearby loaded locations only (32 tiles per move). The script waits for observed arrival.

Commands.Label: Run to a location
Commands.Help: Running version of walk.to. You can also use a scanned tile's loop name.

Commands.Label: Stop walking
Commands.Help: Stops assistant pathfinding.

Commands.Label: Wait for a window
Commands.Help: Match text or server serial. Exactly one complete matching server window must be open.

Commands.Label: Press a button
Commands.Help: Follows gumps.wait. A quoted exact button label works when the client supplies it; otherwise choose its button number.

Commands.Label: Wait for a menu
Commands.Help: Waits for one matching server menu.

Commands.Label: Choose a menu option
Commands.Help: Follows menus.wait. A quoted exact option label is also accepted.

Commands.Label: Answer a prompt
Commands.Help: Waits for a prompt and submits this text.

Commands.Label: Answer a text entry
Commands.Help: Waits for a text entry window and submits this text.

Commands.Label: Start fresh messages
Commands.Help: Marks the current point in your journal; does not erase the game's journal.

Commands.Label: Wait for a message
Commands.Help: Only new system messages count, beginning at the script start or journal.clear.

Commands.Label: Wait
Commands.Help: Use seconds or ms. Each wait may be at most 30 seconds.

Commands.Label: Show a message
Commands.Help: Shows a message in script output. This does not speak in game chat.

Commands.Label: Show found results
Commands.Template:
scan.trees within 8 as trees
show trees
Commands.Help: Shows up to twelve loaded results, including names, graphics and coordinates. Window results include visible button details.

Commands.Label: Repeat steps
Commands.Template:
repeat 3 times
    log "Hello"
    wait 1 second
end
Commands.Help: Repeat between 1 and 100 times. All scripts also have a run-time limit.

Commands.Label: Check your health
Commands.Template:
if player.health below 50 percent
    player.cast "Heal" on self
end
Commands.Help: Also supports mana, stamina, weight, items.have, journal.contains, player.dead and player.mounted.

Commands.Label: Visit found trees
Commands.Template:
scan.trees within 8 as trees
for each tree in trees
    walk.to tree within 2
end
Commands.Help: Runs the steps for each found tile. Use break to finish a loop, continue to skip its current item, and stop to finish the script.

Commands.Label: Chop nearby trees (Invicta)
Commands.Help: Invicta recipe: save lumberAxe, equip it, dismount and choose a 30-minute run limit. Stops for damage, weight or unknown replies; reports skipped trees. Other shards may use different messages.

Commands.Label: Stop the script
Commands.Help: Finishes the script immediately; the Stop button can also cancel a running script.

Examples.Name: Start here — open your backpack
Examples.Source:
# Each line is one step. Nothing runs until you press Run.
player.backpack
log "Your backpack is open."

Examples.Name: Heal yourself
Examples.Source:
if player.health below 75 percent
    player.cast "Heal" on self
end

Examples.Name: Use an item on yourself
Examples.Source:
# Save the item as bandages with Choose an object.
items.use saved "bandages" on self

Examples.Name: Find nearby trees
Examples.Source:
scan.trees within 12 as trees
show trees

Examples.Name: Find cave tiles
Examples.Source:
scan.caves within 8 as caves
show caves

Examples.Name: Walk around found trees
Examples.Source:
scan.trees within 8 as trees
for each tree in trees
    walk.to tree within 2
end

Examples.Name: Chop nearby trees — Invicta
Examples.Source:
# Equip your axe, save it as lumberAxe, and dismount.
# Stops if hurt, nearly full or a reply is not recognised.
trees.chop nearby using "lumberAxe" within 12

Examples.Name: Put logs into a bag
Examples.Source:
# Open your backpack and wood bag. Choose an object saves its name.
items.move graphic 0x1BDD to saved "wood bag" amount all from backpack

Examples.Name: Move ten bandages
Examples.Source:
# Open both bags and save supplies as the destination.
items.move graphic 0x0E21 to saved "supplies" amount 10 from backpack

Examples.Name: Press a window button
Examples.Source:
# Replace the window text and button number with those from your shard.
gumps.wait "craft" timeout 5 seconds
gumps.press button 1

Examples.Name: Wait for new journal text
Examples.Source:
journal.clear
items.use saved "my item"
journal.wait "You put some" timeout 10 seconds

Examples.Name: Repeat a skill
Examples.Source:
repeat 3 times
    player.skill "Hiding"
    wait 10 seconds
end
